verdict.rationale: Unleash documents segments as reusable collections of strategy constraints that can be defined once and reused across any number of flags. It also documents activation strategies that target specific users, constraints built on context fields with operators (e.g. currentTime with DATE_AFTER), and strategy variants that expose different versions to users. A dated, hedged community remark that Unleash's rules are 'more limited' than LaunchDarkly's is not a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: detailed evidence of the range of attribute operators and custom context fields, and independent hands-on corroboration of complex rule targeting.
